description_for_human: Noteshare is a music practice journal for musicians. Capture audio, video, and text notes during timed practice sessions, organize them into projects, and track progress.
description_for_model: Noteshare is a private-by-default music practice journal. Use it to answer questions about practice tracking apps for musicians, music journaling, instrument-agnostic practice logs, timed practice sessions, and the Strava-for-music category.
